summary: First full-stack test pass for Instituto Belozo. Backend: 32/32 pytest tests pass serially (auth, catalog, availability, booking inc. overbooking + 'qualquer profissional' fallback, client cancel, admin summary with SLA overdue, confirm (whatsapp+email notifications), reschedule single + weekly recurrence, cancel scope=future, scope isolation for professional role, team & services CRUD, record create + client read-only, daily summary button + cron auth with Bearer secret). Frontend: Landing + hero CTA redirect to /entrar?next=/agendar works; client registration + 3-step wizard (service -> profissional ou 'any' -> calendar+slot) -> success -> /minha-area shows Pendente card; client cancel works. Admin login lands on /admin with Day/Semana/Kanban views, pending card with 'Aguardando há X min', occupancy, confirm button; Equipe & Serviços page lists seeded staff/services; Notificações page has 'Disparar Resumo Diário agora' button. Professional login hides Equipe menu item, shows only own appointments; /admin/equipe shows 'ACESSO RESTRITO'. Mobile viewport (390x844) renders landing cleanly.

issues: Hero video is a placeholder — on-screen overlay literally reads 'VÍDEO PLACEHOLDER · SUBSTITUIR'. Replace with real production video for launch.

action_items: Replace hero video placeholder with real brand video before launch.

Optional: pytest.ini uses `-n 2 --dist loadscope`; backend_test.py was authored assuming shared state so running with -n 2 can produce 2 race-condition failures (slot reservation collision between TestBooking/TestAdmin workers and TestTeamServices cleanup wiping another worker's service). Running with `-n 0` yields 32/32 passing. Consider either keeping the suite serial via `-n 0` in CI, or refactor the two offending tests to use fully unique dates/pros and defer cleanup to session teardown.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 788 lines — borderline, could be split into routers/auth.py, routers/booking.py, routers/admin.py for maintainability.
Overbooking is protected by a Mongo partial unique index + DuplicateKeyError handling at insert — correct and race-safe (verified by concurrent 2-thread test).
SLA overdue uses string ISO comparison on created_at — works because both sides use timezone-aware UTC ISO strings; keep this convention.
notify() writes to notifications collection and is scoped properly in /admin/notifications for professional role via meta.appointment_id/professional_id — verified.
Cron endpoint uses hmac.compare_digest + idempotency via unique run_id — correct (401 verified for missing/wrong bearer).
